Certificate Management–specific vocabulary — what translates differently in zh-Hans

MDM certificate and PKI marketing on App Store pages uses vocabulary general localization guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese App Store readers evaluate Certificate Management — not a literal paste of US marketing:

证书管理 (Certificate Management)

Apple's Chinese MDM and enterprise support materials use 证书管理 for MDM workflows that enroll, install, renew, revoke, and trust certificates on managed devices. AppLocale picks the term IT admins recognize on each screenshot — a SCEP enrollment frame needs 证书管理-friendly phrasing; a technical badge may keep SCEP when accurate to your English source.

SCEP

SCEP (Simple Certificate Enrollment Protocol) is widely recognized by MDM and PKI buyers globally. zh-Hans marketing often keeps SCEP on technical frames that show enrollment URLs, challenge passwords, or SCEP gateway configuration — alongside 证书注册 for buyer-facing benefit copy.

身份证书 (identity certificate)

MDM platforms issue user and device identity certificates for authentication, Wi-Fi EAP-TLS, VPN, email signing, and S/MIME. zh-Hans copy uses 身份证书 on frames that explain user or device identity credential lifecycle — distinct from consumer Passkeys or Security Keys marketing.

证书注册 / 证书续期 / 证书吊销 (enrollment / renewal / revocation)

Certificate lifecycle stages map to 证书注册 (enrollment), 证书续期 (renewal), and 证书吊销 (revocation) in zh-Hans MDM documentation. Use these terms when your English source markets install, renew, or revoke workflows — not generic "manage security" overclaims.

MDM 证书 (MDM certificate)

Device management and identity certificates delivered through MDM are often described as MDM 证书 in zh-Hans enterprise marketing — separate from MDM server engineering or enrollment portal setup copy.

证书信任 (certificate trust)

Trust anchor installation, certificate chain validation, and identity credential trust workflows use 证书信任 on frames that show trust store configuration — distinct from consumer "verify your identity" marketing unless your English source genuinely shows trust UI.

Subtitle and keyword packing

The 30-character subtitle and 100-character keyword field need MDM and PKI search terms Chinese buyers type — see Simplified Chinese keywords & subtitle for field mechanics. Terms like 证书管理, SCEP, and 身份证书 each signal different intent from 配置描述文件, Enterprise SSO, or 托管 Apple ID keywords.

AppLocale FAQ

What is Apple Certificate Management and why does listing copy matter?

Certificate Management covers SCEP enrollment, identity certificates, MDM certificate install/renew/revoke, certificate trust, and identity credential workflows on managed devices. Marketing those workflows on your en-US page does not auto-fill zh-Hans Connect fields.

Does SCEP or certificate lifecycle support auto-translate my China listing?

No. Certificate enrollment and MDM PKI are runtime workflows — they do not create or fill a Simplified Chinese localization row. Empty or English zh-Hans fields mean China buyers see en-US fallback on the product page.

How is this different from Configuration Profiles, Enterprise SSO, or Managed Apple ID?

Certificate Management listing copy markets SCEP enrollment and MDM certificate install/renew/revoke lifecycle. Configuration Profile listing copy markets installable .mobileconfig payload files broadly. Enterprise SSO listing copy markets org sign-in extensions. Managed Apple ID listing copy markets organization Apple accounts. Listing vocabulary must follow your English lead feature — do not lead Certificate Management with .mobileconfig Wi-Fi/VPN profile marketing.

How is this different from Passkeys, Security Keys, Return to Service, or Activation Lock?

Certificate Management enrolls and renews MDM PKI credentials. Passkeys and Security Keys market consumer WebAuthn authentication. Return to Service erases supervised devices for fleet redeployment. Activation Lock prevents consumer reactivation without the owner's Apple ID after erase. Each is a separate Apple feature — do not reuse boilerplate across them.
